_comment: Machine-readable identity of the frozen simulation release that this
paper package describes. paper_guard and paper_audit read this file
rather than hard-coding the values. The main release and separately
frozen EXP11 supplemental anchor are both recorded here.
The SHA is authoritative, not the tag. The tag is a convenience label
that may be missing from a remote or, in a damaged repository, may point
somewhere else; the commit it must point to is fixed here. Verification
is therefore anchored to the peeled commit SHA.
DO NOT move, recreate or re-point the tag to satisfy a check. A missing
remote tag is a release-publication blocker requiring owner action.

note: Because the tag is annotated, 'git rev-parse simulation-v1.0' returns
the TAG OBJECT sha (ba8ddcc), not the commit. Resolve with
A checker that compares rev-parse output directly against the commit
sha will report a spurious mismatch.
paperBaseCommit is the accepted paper-v1 package commit. It is a
descendant of the frozen sha, so the frozen tree is reachable and
every frozen path can be diffed against it.

supplementalEvidence.relationshipToFrozen: supplemental evidence outside simulation-v1.0 boundary; paper may cite and use it
note: EXP11 is not part of simulation-v1.0 and must never move that release boundary.
The paper-generated EXP11 numbers are rebuilt only from the full 50-seed persisted run.

excludedPostTagCommits.subject: Record the confirmation validation run at the simulation-v1.0 tree
why: This commit records a second validation pass executed AGAINST the
tagged tree. It is evidence about the release, not part of it.
Committing a validation log necessarily moves HEAD past the commit
the log describes, so the log can only ever live after the tag.
The release boundary must not be moved to swallow it.
